description: Rothco’s Subdued Viet MAC-SOG Patch measures 2 ½” x 3 ½” and is made with polyester material and cotton thread. Embroidered on the front of this subdued military patch is “MAC SOG”, which stands for Military Advisory Command Vietnam, Studies and Observation Group. Rothco’s Viet MAC – SOG patch is an iron on/sew on military patch.
